title: RunPod verification sweep - one Pod session, every Pod-only check
description: UMBRELLA. Shipped work keeps accumulating a single outstanding item: "run it once on a Pod". Spinning a Pod per card is absurd, so they queue here and clear in ONE session. Pick this card up, spin the Pod, walk brief.md top to bottom, then close the member cards it clears. The brief also names what a Pod CANNOT settle - a remote run is not proof of a LOCAL engine on Linux/mac, and it says nothing about macOS install - so those cards stay off this list on purpose.
activeSessionTitle: Pod verification sweep - one session, every Pod-only check
acceptance: Run as ONE Pod session: connect once, walk every item, tear down once. Cost is the whole point of the umbrella

MPI-380 (SAM3 points on a Pod) - check the NEWLY ADDED engineAsset installs on the remote path FIRST; its own validation.md names that as the likeliest failure. Also confirm no points PNG reaches staging
MPI-384 (SAM3 text on a Pod) - the prompt must arrive as TEXT. CLIPTextEncode is not in PATH_MEDIA_CLASSES so this should be a non-event; MPI-380 hit exactly this trap on the points branch
MPI-346 (krea2edit v1.2.2) - the .mpi_node_commit drift ladder must reinstall the node at the new commit on connect. Then one Krea2 edit and one describe THROUGH THE APP
MPI-135 (DC-steer, HAS NO CARD) - logic-verified only, needs a maintenance host. Carry it here or it stays lost
A member card only closes when its OWN check passed. A green Pod session that skipped an item closes nothing

NOT on this card and must not be attempted here: MPI-198 (needs a LOCAL engine on Linux/mac - a Pod is a REMOTE engine and proves nothing about it), MPI-370 (needs a real Mac), MPI-369 (local boot smoke)
Append findings to each member cards validation.md, not to this one. This card holds the LIST, the members hold the evidence
